name: Precise Records, Unstable Meanings: Measurement Validity and Unsupported Claims Derived from AI Agent Telemetry
description: This paper audits whether operational telemetry actually measures the sessions, tasks, outcomes, behaviors, and failure rates later attributed to it. It separates valid record-level quantities from unsupported construct-level interpretations and introduces a Telemetry-to-Claim Gate covering producer provenance, analytical unit, construct, population, observation window, denominator, validation evidence, and sensitivity.
